capabilities: Reveal hidden dot-folders and dotfiles via settings or commands
Index revealed files for search, links, and Bases
Watch revealed folders for live file changes
Filter indexed files by extension allowlist and folder exclusions
Map unclaimed extensions so revealed files open as editable text
extras: Desktop only: it patches undocumented FileSystemAdapter methods with no public API. Warns that revealed .env contents become searchable and visible to sync. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes a source-file layout section.
problem: Obsidian hides dot-entries and never indexes them, so config and project files inside the vault stay invisible and unsearchable.
summary: Vault-internals plugin that reveals hidden dot-folders and dotfiles (.claude, .github, .env) in the file explorer, search, and Bases.
